svg.title: Rickashay concept art: the field in play, aiming on a phone and a flight in the air in a wide window
svg.text: Two draft levels, as the sketch played them. Nothing here is charged: the aim is the whole shot.
The guide runs to the flight's third turn.
A flight in the air, in a wide window
Its path so far, its rally beside it, the floor bounces it holds, and the panels a wide room has space for.
